## SCN-006 — task_create persists a todo task with an allocated PREFIX-NNN id

**Kind:** `happy_path`
**Status:** `draft`
**Anchor:** `docs/system/capabilities/task-creation#0-as-implemented-2026-09-15`

### Preconditions

A plan with at least one section exists in project `cod-doc`.

### Steps

1. Call MCP `task_create` with plan_scope, section_letter, title, type and priority
2. Read the created task via `task_get`

### Expected result

The task exists with status `todo` and a `PREFIX-NNN` task_id.

### Notes

TSC-002. Claims match code as of 2026-09-15.

## SCN-007 — Direct todo→in_progress without checkout is refused

**Kind:** `error_path`
**Status:** `draft`
**Anchor:** `docs/system/capabilities/task-creation#0-as-implemented-2026-09-15`

### Preconditions

A task exists in status `todo` and is not checked out.

### Steps

1. Call `task_update_status` to `in_progress` without `via_checkout=True`

### Expected result

`StatusTransitionError` is raised (ADO-039).

### Notes

TSC-002. Claims match code as of 2026-09-15.

## SCN-008 — MCP task_create rejects a duplicate title unless allow_duplicate

**Kind:** `boundary_value`
**Status:** `draft`
**Anchor:** `docs/system/capabilities/task-creation#0-as-implemented-2026-09-15`

### Preconditions

A task with a given title already exists in the project.

### Steps

1. Call `task_create` with the same title and `allow_duplicate=False`

### Expected result

`DuplicateTaskError` is raised; the existing task is named as `duplicate_of`.

### Notes

TSC-002. Claims match code as of 2026-09-15.

## SCN-009 — complete() from todo still performs the checkout leg

**Kind:** `invariant`
**Status:** `draft`
**Anchor:** `docs/system/capabilities/task-creation#0-as-implemented-2026-09-15`

### Preconditions

A task exists in `todo` and is not locked.

### Steps

1. Call `task_complete` with a commit sha

### Expected result

The task becomes `done`; no separate checkout call was required (ADO-038).

### Notes

TSC-002. Claims match code as of 2026-09-15.
